description: Contains identifiers for auxiliary files associated with Nanostring GeoMx Spatial Profiling experiments.

NanoStringGeoMxAuxiliaryFilesId.description: Unique row identifier, used as a primary key for record updates. This should be equivalent to the file Synapse Id unless otherwise indicated.
NanoStringGeoMxAuxiliaryFilesId.title: NanoStringGeoMxAuxiliaryFiles_id

SynapseIDofGeoMxDSPConfigFile.description: Synapse ID of config.ini file generated by the GeoMx DSP workflow.
SynapseIDofGeoMxDSPConfigFile.title: Synapse ID of GeoMx DSP Config File

SynapseIDofGeoMxDSPPKCFile.description: The Synapse ID(s) associated with the PKC mapping file for the assay. Multiple files are listed as comma separated values.
SynapseIDofGeoMxDSPPKCFile.title: Synapse ID of GeoMx DSP PKC File

SynapseIDofGeoMxDSPROISegmentAnnotationF.description: Synapse ID(s) for ROI/AOI/Segmentation annotations in the GeoMx DSP experiment.
SynapseIDofGeoMxDSPROISegmentAnnotationF.title: Synapse ID of GeoMx DSP ROI Segment Annotation File

SynapseIDofGeoMxLabWorksheetFile.description: Synapse ID(s) of Lab Worksheet Files output from the GeoMx DSP workflow. Multiple files are listed as comma separated values.
SynapseIDofGeoMxLabWorksheetFile.title: Synapse ID of GeoMx Lab Worksheet File
